name: Heel Raises
summary: Legs stay long while the heels lower under the footbar and lift again. Works and lengthens the calves.
steps: Lie on the back, balls of the feet on the footbar hip-width apart, arms long by the sides.
Breathe out to press the carriage away until the legs are straight.
Breathe in to let both heels sink under the bar.
Breathe out to rise as high onto the toes as you can, legs still long.

layers.title: Slow lower
layers.text: Three counts down, one count up.

layers.title: Single leg
layers.text: One foot on the bar, the other leg in tabletop.

modifications: Take a spring off if the legs can't straighten with control.
Smaller range for sore ankles or Achilles.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Only the ankles move.
Smooth and steady — no bouncing at the bottom.
Press through the big-toe side so the feet don't roll outwards.
Pelvis and spine stay in neutral.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
